title: Pay Run
guardrail: Simulation with made-up numbers. Real life is different.

start.tagline: A part-time job. Eight weeks. A goal worth {{goal}}.
start.note: The price tag is made up.
start.confirm: Start again from week 1? Your saved weeks will be cleared.

focus.label: This week's question
focus.w1: Where does my money actually go?
focus.w3: Why does money put away first last longer than money saved from what is left?
focus.w4: What do I do when something breaks and I have no money for it?
focus.w6: Why do I regret some purchases? And what does this really cost me?
focus.w7: If I borrow ₹200, what do I really pay?
focus.w8: How do I say yes or no when a friend asks for money?
focus.bonus: A free week. Everything you've learned, your way.

payday.title: Payday!
payday.musthave: Must-haves: travel, food at home, phone

plan.title: Plan your week

lunch.name: Packed Lunch
lunch.desc: Food treats cost half. Phone top-up and game pack stay the same.

save.name: Saving share
save.desc: This share of your wage goes into the jar at Payday, before you can spend it.

waitlist.name: Wait List
waitlist.desc: Adds an "Add to list" button on wants. Listed things are not bought now.

plan.moveNote: Money in the jar can't be spent on treats or wants, and it counts towards your goal.
plan.stillwantNote: You put this on your list last week.
plan.locked: More rules unlock in later weeks.
